**User Story:** As an operator, I want drag-and-drop, vim-style keyboard shortcuts, theme toggle, the Epics table, and a print stylesheet so I can move work, navigate without a mouse, and archive a clean B&W report.

> Final polish layer. Builds on Epics #4, #5, #6.

## Goal

Make the app powerful for daily use. Wire `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable` for column reorder and task→column moves with optimistic UI. Add the full keyboard shortcut suite from `FrontEngDesign.md §7` (`j/k/Enter/Esc/g-b/g-e/n/c/?/t`) via a `HotkeyProvider`. Implement the theme toggle (`t` keypress + `◑` chrome glyph) with `localStorage.theme` and `system` default. Build the Epics table at `/epics` with `ProgressSparkbar` (`█░` mono block characters) and sortable columns. Add the print stylesheet (`@media print`) that expands all collapsed sections and renders the board as a B&W report.

- [ ] Dragging a column header reorders columns; `PATCH /api/columns/reorder` is called; order persists across page refresh.
- [ ] Dragging a task card onto a different column header updates `column_id` optimistically; `PATCH /api/tasks/{id}` is called; persists across refresh.

- [ ] Clicking a column header sorts the table; sort indicator is a `↑`/`↓` glyph in `--c-ink-3`.
- [ ] `Cmd+P` (print preview) on `/` shows the full board with all columns expanded and journal entries inline, no chrome controls, B&W enforced.
- [ ] Playwright E2E `e2e/dnd-and-theme.spec.ts` passes.

## Tasks

2. #29 — DnD: task between columns + optimistic update

**Part of:** #5

## Context

The Board view (T2.3+) needs a short preview line per task without fetching every Markdown file's full contents. Backend reads the linked Markdown file, takes the first paragraph (text up to first `\n\n`), strips Markdown noise (headings, code-fence markers, bold/italic), truncates to 240 chars with ellipsis, and returns it as `excerpt: string` on `GET /api/tasks` and `GET /api/epics` list responses. Cached in-process keyed by `(content_path, mtime)` to keep polling cheap.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/tasks` response items include `excerpt: str` (≤ 240 chars).
- [ ] `GET /api/epics` response items include `excerpt: str` (≤ 240 chars).
- [ ] If the linked file is missing, `excerpt` is `""` (not an error).
- [ ] Cache invalidates on file `mtime` change; verified by a test that mutates a temp file and re-fetches.
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_excerpt.py -v` passes (4+ assertions: shape, truncation, file-missing, mtime invalidation).
- [ ] `mypy app/ --strict` clean. `ruff check app/` clean.

## Files

- Modify: `app/main.py` (extend tasks/epics list endpoints)
- Create: `app/excerpt.py` (extraction + cache)
- Create: `tests/test_excerpt.py`

## Implementation Notes

- `app/excerpt.py`: `def get_excerpt(data_dir: Path, content_path: str) -> str` and a module-level `_cache: dict[str, tuple[float, str]]` keyed by content_path → (mtime, excerpt).
- Extraction: `text = path.read_text(); para = text.split('\n\n', 1)[0]; cleaned = re.sub(r'^#+\s*', '', para); cleaned = re.sub(r'[*_`]+', '', cleaned); cleaned = cleaned[:240].rstrip() + ('…' if len(cleaned) > 240 else '')`.
- File missing: catch `FileNotFoundError`, return `""`.
- In `main.py`, after fetching the SQL rows, map each to add `excerpt = get_excerpt(...)`.
- Update Pydantic response models in `app/main.py` to include `excerpt: str = ""`.
- The cache is per-process (in-memory); fine for our single-process server.

## Verify

```bash
cd kanban && .venv/Scripts/pytest tests/test_excerpt.py -v

.venv/Scripts/ruff check app/
```

**Part of:** #5

## Context

Wire the visual signal for new data: (a) the `◇` glyph in the chrome (T1.4 placeholder) pulses to `--c-signal` for ~80 ms each time a poll returns *new* data; (b) the inset signal-rule on TaskCards with `data-new` fades from `--c-signal` to `--c-ink-4` over 8 seconds via CSS transition.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `frontend/src/system/PollIndicator.tsx` subscribes to `useIsFetching()` from TanStack Query and detects edge transitions; emits a one-shot CSS class on `◇` that flashes `--c-signal` for 80 ms via `--m-fast`.
- [ ] TaskCard CSS: `data-new` element has `box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--c-signal)` initially and transitions to `inset 1px 0 0 var(--c-ink-4)` over 8 s linear (the §2.5 `--m-fade`).
- [ ] After the 8 s transition, the inset shadow disappears entirely (animation removes the data-new attribute via `useEffect` setTimeout).
- [ ] Reduced-motion: when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, no fade — show the `--c-signal` rule for the full 8 s window then disappear instantly.
- [ ] Vitest test with fake timers: render TaskCard with `isNew=true`, assert inset shadow class present; advance 8 s; assert removed.

- Create: `frontend/src/system/PollIndicator.tsx`
- Modify: `frontend/src/components/chrome/TopRule.tsx` (mount PollIndicator on the `◇` glyph)
